extension.description: Skin NikeFlix is the NikeFlix home-theatre skin for Kodi Omega. It is a modified version of Titan BINGIE MOD 2.2.8 (AchillesPunks & Matke), which is based on Titan BINGIE (cartman.dos) and Titan (marcelveldt). Licensed under GPL-2.0-only; see NOTICE.md and CREDITS.md.
extension.news: [B]Skin NikeFlix 1.1.13[/B][CR]Switch profile waits until the profile has settled and its background services stand still, so a switch no longer hangs Kodi or has to kill them. During playback it stops playback first. It closes only the power menu; with another window open it asks you to close it and try again. Opening Home no longer rewrites skin settings that are already set.[CR][B]Skin NikeFlix 1.0.0[/B][CR]First NikeFlix release, forked from Titan BINGIE MOD 2.2.8. See NIKEFLIX-CHANGES.md.
